We need to determine crimes based on facts. The facts: Meng (孟) is legal representative of a cooperative. He stole 1451 trees (林木) from national forest without approval, value 27,465 yuan. Also occupied forest land (protected forest, water source conservation forest) to build pig farm, covering 5.97 mu (approx 0.4 ha). So crimes: illegal logging/ theft of forest resources (illegal logging, theft of forest resources). In Chinese criminal law, there is crime of "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护的森林、草原、湿地等自然资源罪" maybe "非法采伐、毁坏森林罪". Also "非法占用林地" maybe "非法占用农用地" but forest land is protected, so "非法占用林地罪". Also "盗窃" of forest resources: theft of forest resources is "盗伐林木罪"? Actually Chinese law: Article 322 of Criminal Law: "盗伐林木罪" (theft of forest trees). Also "非法占用林地罪" (Article 338?). Let's see typical classification in examples: For illegal logging they used "非法采伐、毁坏森林" maybe "非法采伐、毁坏森林罪". In earlier examples: "非法携带枪支进入公共场所" they used "非法携带枪支、弹药、管制刀具、危险物品危及公共安全". For "非法占用林地" they might use "非法占用林地罪". Also "盗伐林木" is theft of forest resources. So we need list of crimes: "盗伐林木罪" and "非法占用林地罪". Also maybe "非法占用国家重点保护的森林" is "非法占用林地罪". So answer: [罪名]盗伐林木;非法占用林地<eoa>
